Our Services

Everything you need to glow

From a fresh haircut to your complete bridal look — yeh rahi hamari services ki list.

Haircut & Styling

Trendy cuts, layers, blowouts and styling for every hair type — a look that suits your face and your everyday style.

Hair Colour

Global colour, highlights, balayage and fashion shades — along with smoothening, keratin and hair spa care for healthy, shiny hair.

Facials & Skin Care

Deep-cleansing facials, cleanup, de-tan and glow treatments that leave your skin fresh, soft and naturally radiant.

Makeup

Party makeup, engagement looks and HD makeup for your special days — natural, long-lasting and photo-ready.

Bridal Packages

Complete bridal makeup with hairstyling and draping — plus pre-bridal skin and hair care so you shine on your big day.

Waxing & Threading

Smooth, gentle waxing and precise eyebrow threading and shaping — the finishing touches for a clean, polished look.
